buttonRules: Buttons and button-like anchors use cursor pointer unless disabled.
Do not add one-off button variants.
Button shadows, if used, must be tiny and precise.
sectionRules: Use page canvas, whitespace, typography, and alignment before adding surfaces.
Do not wrap every section in a rounded panel.
Do not use gradients, noisy backgrounds, or decorative blobs.
galleryRules: Use stable grid rhythm, not masonry.
Large hubs must use pagination or limited initial rendering.
Image tiles use one preview canvas with text and actions below.
Do not create indexable per-image pages.
cardRules: No resting-state borders on layout surfaces.
Hub promos should feel like editorial navigation, not generic SaaS cards.
Use cards only for individual repeated items, modals, or genuinely framed tools.
focusVisibleRules: Every interactive control must have a visible focus-visible treatment.
The focus-visible outline is the only allowed outline or ring exception.
Do not use outline: none unless an equivalent accessible focus style is present.
pageLevelRules: Public gallery pages use the light Indigo Paper shell.
Use native links and buttons for interactions.
Gallery media resolves through the centralized asset resolver.
Any new public page must declare page type, indexability status, metadata strategy, and component variants used.
